meta.name: Red Queen
meta.description: A gifted woman's intellect brings chance to lead covert European police force. But it backfires, costing her everything. Following murder at her home and kidnapped heiress, her ex-supervisor enlists a policeman's aid to reinstate her.

videos.title: A Leap
videos.overview: Antonia Scott is the most intelligent woman in the world –a virtue and a curse at the same time. Her intelligence allowed her to become the "Red Queen" of a secret experimental police project. But a personal tragedy removed her from active duty. Now, Jon Gutiérrez, a police officer in trouble, has to get her out of her seclusion to solve a case that will put her abilities and her past to the test.

videos.title: A Tattoo
videos.overview: Ezequiel has assassinated Álvaro Trueba and has kidnapped Carla Ortiz, both the firstborn of the most powerful families in Spain. Jon agrees to be Antonia's squire. Even though they started off with the wrong foot, they're about to catch Ezequiel after a fast-paced chase that has everyone on edge. In her cell, Carla finds out that she is not Ezequiel's only prisoner.

videos.title: A Pill
videos.overview: Antonia and Jon have barely started and they have already got the Kidnapping Unit, Ramón Ortiz, Laura Trueba and the shadow leader of Reina Roja, Mentor, against them. During the course of the investigation, everyone lies. Antonia and Jon realize that what Ezequiel has asked of Ortiz and Trueba is an admission of guilt. But Ezequiel is always one step ahead and now his threat looms over Antonia.

videos.title: A Spanish Tortilla
videos.overview: Antonia wakes up alone facing a mural. Why didn't Ezequiel kill her? The assassin wanted to deliver a message. A message that leads Antonia and Jon to a taxi car and to discover the true identity behind Ezequiel. The Kidnapping Unit has also found Ezequiel's address and taxi car, but Antonia notices that the pieces don't fit together as neatly...

videos.title: A Choice
videos.overview: Antonia and Jon find out Ezequiel's daughter is helping him, but things don't add up. They have committed too many mistakes. But when the Kidnapping Unit falls into a trap, they realize they weren't mistakes. Carla discovers the truth about the kidnapped woman in the other cell. Jon makes a blunder that causes Mentor to close the case and remove Antonia from her position as the Spanish Red Queen.

videos.title: A Disguise
videos.overview: Antonia's father accuses her of kidnapping her own son and is about to get her arrested, but Jon helps her escape. Alone and with all the city police behind her, Antonia seeks to hide in order to think of a rescue plan for her child. With the help of her memories, her mind, her old friends... and a costume, Antonia is about to take on the most important mission of her life.

videos.title: A Mirror
videos.overview: Jon and Antonia get back together. The Queen and her squire have little time left and must go to underground tunnels riddled with traps and bombs. Sandra and Ezequiel are waiting for them and the lives of Jorge and Carla are at stake. But Antonia knows this is not over. Sandra is not who she says she is, but just a prophet of someone more powerful who already destroyed what Antonia loved most.

videos.title: A Corpse
videos.overview: Months after the Fajardo case, Antonia remains fixated on White and Sandra, while Jon longs for love. In Marbella, someone tries to kill Lola, wife of Yuri, treasurer to mob boss Orlov. Mentor sends Antonia and Jon to find her before Orlov does. They arrive to find Yuri murdered, with detectives Romero and Belgrano offering troubling leads. Meanwhile, a woman in Germany takes her life.

videos.title: A Funeral
videos.overview: Orlov sees the attack on Lola on TV and calls Black Wolf to track her down. Antonia and Jon investigate the front business run by Lola's mother and attend Yuri's funeral. Jon discovers Heimdal, a surveillance software Antonia has kept from him, while Lola searches for shelter and insulin. Following the trail of dirty money, Antonia and Jon find a container with a horrific discovery.

videos.title: A Container
videos.overview: In the container, Antonia and Jon find nine dead girls and one survivor. Lola sees the news about the murdered girls and decides to retrieve her dog, asking her maid for help. Orlov kills his front man, the one Yuri worked with, but his enforcers come face-to-face with Black Wolf, who also confronts Jon and Antonia. Antonia begins to suspect that Black Wolf is working on her own.

videos.title: A High
videos.overview: To pay her maid, Lola goes to a loan shark whom she ends up killing. She flees the police after a shootout, helped by Black Wolf. Orlov learns Yuri was stealing from him and now wants Lola alive. Across Europe, Red Queens are dying. Mentor orders Jon and Antonia back to Madrid. They disobey. Antonia deduces Lola is the mastermind behind everything, then vanishes, leaving Jon a cryptic message.

videos.title: A Dog
videos.overview: Antonia tells Orlov Lola is the one stealing from him, but she is tortured. Jon rescues her with Black Wolf's quiet help. Lola looks for her dog but, betrayed by her maid, is captured by one of Orlov's men. The police arrest Lola and Orlov's man, but Romero causes a crash to get rid of her. The maid takes the dog to a house. Lola and Orlov's man head there. Antonia has a revelation about Romero.

videos.title: A Sunrise
videos.overview: At the mountain house, Antonia discovers that the dog carries a chip containing Orlov's stolen money. She, Jon and Black Wolf hold off the assault by Orlov, Romero and Belgrano. Lola loses the chip, which Black Wolf takes. Back in Madrid, Antonia disconnects her husband's life support and realizes that Mr. White is behind Black Wolf. When she goes to warn Jon, she witnesses Sandra kidnapping him.
